notes: Order matters: rate_for returns the FIRST matching pattern, and prefix globs overlap (claude-sonnet-4* also matches claude-sonnet-4-6). Keep specific patterns above general ones.

KNOWN GAP — cache writes actually bill by time-to-live tier: 1.25x base input for the 5-minute cache but 2x for the 1-hour cache. This schema carries a single write multiplier, so 1-hour writes are priced at 1.25x and understated. Agentic sessions write predominantly 1-hour caches, so this understates real cost; measured at roughly 13% low on Claude Code traffic. Fixing it means reading usage.cache_creation.ephemeral_{5m,1h}_input_tokens in parse.py and adding a second multiplier here.
Cache read (hit) is 0.1x base input for every current model, which the default multiplier already matches.
